title: ci(ui): regenerate the SDUI manifest in Build & E2E UI and compare it with the committed bytes (#26137 PR A)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAqVfFyhsxKuFcEP9YTBj25)_

Part of #26137 (PR A of two: the CI comparison; PR B retires the per-package records once this is green on `main`). Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`).
Part of objectstack#25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** `Build & E2E UI` 多了一步:用 `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` 从本树重新生成 `sdui.manifest.json`,再和提交的文件逐字节比较,不一致就红,并打印差异和修复命令。`ci.yml` 的 `ui` 过滤器加了 turbo 的四个全局依赖文件,以及清单自己的四个文件。原来 lint 里按源码摘要判新鲜度的检查保留不动。
- **为什么改:** 摘要只读各 registry 包的 `src/`,看不见三类变化:解析器 `@objectstack/sdui-parser` 的改动、registry 运行时引用的 `@objectstack` 包的改动、两个排队 PR 合起来的效果。实测:在 `main` 上改 `manifestFromConfigs` 一行,现有检查仍是绿的,而重新生成的清单差了 87 行。现在 PR 和合并队列的合并树上都会重新生成并比较。
- **哪些原来能合的现在会被拒:** 只有清单确实过期的 PR。今天 `main` 重新生成与提交的字节完全一致。
- **代价:** 每次跑 ui 的 run 多约 3.6 分钟 runner 时间(27 个 `@object-ui` 包冷构建 3m25s,枚举 8s;36 个 `@objectstack` 任务从 Build UI Deps 回放)。今天 22 次绿 run 里 ui 尾部都比它长,所以墙钟时间增加 0。`Build & E2E UI` 超时按规则重算为 35 分钟。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 CI 和文档,不发布任何包。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **你要做的:** Tier H,需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 审批。

## 席位核对

(left for the dispatch seat)

## Why

`check-sdui-manifest` (lint, every PR) judges the committed `sdui.manifest.json` fresh when each registry package's `src/` digest equals its one-line record under `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/` (#26051, #26120). That digest is blind to everything outside those `src/` trees that moves the artefact:

- **the serialiser itself**, `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, which the generator imports from `packages/sdui-parser/dist`. Since the lockstep gate retired (#26221) nothing ties a parser edit to the records, and after 2g PR 2 deletes `ui/packages/sdui-parser` the records stop reaching any parser at all (#26137 comment 6420796812);
- **the `@objectstack` packages the registry imports at runtime** (`spec`, `client`, `core`, `formula`, `types`), and any `package.json` or lockfile change;
- **two queued PRs** that each leave the artefact unchanged and change it together, the residual the maintainer accepted for #26120.

### Before: the gap on `main`, measured

On `main` 81bba6c3f, in `packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts` `manifestFromConfigs`, `isContainer: c.isContainer` → `isContainer: c.isContainer ?? false`:

- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: **exit 0**, "present, intact … each package's digest current in its record";
- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: `sdui.manifest.json` **1 file changed, 87 insertions(+)**.

So a stale manifest passes today. With this PR, the same edit reds `Build & E2E UI` on the PR, because `packages/sdui-parser/**` is in `ui_consumers` and the step serialises through the parser the job just built.

## What changes

### `ci.yml`, `Build & E2E UI`: the comparison

A new step, **"The committed SDUI manifest is the one this tree generates"**, after "Build the @objectstack packages objectui consumes" and before the Console build:

```bash
node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs
if ! git diff --quiet -- sdui.manifest.json; then
  echo "::error file=sdui.manifest.json::…Run 'node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs' and commit what it writes."
  git diff --stat -- sdui.manifest.json
  git diff -- sdui.manifest.json | head -n 200
  exit 1
fi
```

- **What it reuses:** the generator's turbo run is 63 build tasks. 36 are exactly the set `Build UI Deps` builds and hands over, and they replay from the downloaded `ui-deps-turbo-cache`. The other 27 are the `@object-ui` registry closure.
- **What it adds:** on 4 cores, the 27 build in 3m25s cold and the enumeration takes 8s; with nothing moved the whole run takes 6s. The output on `main` is byte-identical to the committed file (sha256 `1f6e1ccb925a…`, 106 components), and two runs agree.
- **Why this job:** it is required already, already replays the 36, and is the shortest ui job (1.9–2.9 min across 22 green runs on 2026-10-26: 14 `pull_request`, 6 `merge_group`, 2 `push`). The ui lane's tail after `Build UI Deps` was 8.4–14.2 min in the same runs, so the added wall time measured 0 in all of them. Lint UI builds the 27 too, but it runs on the `ui` output only, so a PR that changes only the parser or one of the five packages would skip it (#26137 comment 6424273287).
- **What it compares:** only the artefact. The records the generator rewrites beside it stay with `check-sdui-manifest` until PR B.
- **The Console build is unaffected:** `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` aliases every workspace package to its `src/`, so the dist this step builds does not reach it.

### `ci.yml`, the `ui` filter

| Added | Why |
|---|---|
| `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.base.json`, `tsconfig.test.base.json`, `tsup.config.ts` | `turbo.json`'s `globalDependencies`. Every build task hashes them, so they move what the ui jobs build. The digest never saw them either. |
| `sdui.manifest.json`, `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` | The artefact, its record, its producer and its offline gate. A hand edit of the artefact, or a producer edit, now runs the comparison. |

The registry's runtime closure, walked over `dependencies` and `peerDependencies` from the 17 seeds, is the 27 ui packages plus `spec`, `client`, `core`, `formula` and `types`. All of them were under `ui/**` or `ui_consumers` already. Cost of the additions: in the 30 days to 2026-10-26, 2 merged PRs moved one of the eight paths and no other ui path (#26120, #25833); each would have run the ui lane once more.

### `ci.yml`, the ceiling

`Build & E2E UI` is re-derived by the rule in the comment above Lint UI. The slowest successful run was 457 s; adding 213 s gives 670 s (11.2 min), so `max(33.5, 26.2)` ⇒ **35**, up from 25. The pin in `ui/scripts/__tests__/turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts` moves with it.

### Prose

- **`lint.yml`:** the `check-sdui-manifest` step comment says where the regeneration now runs. The stale reference to the retired lockstep neighbour goes.
- **`scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` header:** "What this deliberately does NOT do" and check 3's "What is NOT forced" now name the CI step that does it.
- **`docs/releases-maintenance.md`:** one paragraph on the CI comparison.

### Widening or narrowing

**This is a widening.** It adds a check, and no case that the current check refuses passes now: the current check stays on, unchanged. The step goes red only when the committed manifest differs from this tree's regeneration. That is exactly a stale manifest, so nothing an author can write is refused that is not stale.

## What PR B does, after this is green on `main`

It retires check 3 in-tree (the per-package digests) and `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/`. It also updates their readers:

- `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`;
- `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (L1368–1371, L4879, L4966);
- `docs/releases-maintenance.md`;
- `cut-rc.yml` and `release.yml` prose.

After that, PRs conflict only when the manifest's bytes really change. Whichever of PR B and 2g PR 2 lands second rebases on `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/sdui-parser.json`.

## Verification

Head `d36dc4280`, on `main` `ff918954e`. 5 files, +79 / −23, one commit. Tier H: `check-governed-merges --test` exits 3 for `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/lint.yml` and 0 for the other three paths.

- **The regeneration on this head:** `main` here already carries #26211's parser. On `d36dc4280`, `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` wrote **byte-identical** bytes: sha256 `1f6e1ccb925a…`, 106 components, `git status` clean, no record rewritten. So the new step should be green on this PR. With main moved, that run rebuilt 62 of 63 tasks locally in 7m25s; in CI, `Build UI Deps` supplies 36 of them.
- **The gap, before:** see "Before" above (main 81bba6c3f: gate exit 0, regeneration +87 lines).
- **`check-sdui-manifest`:** `--self-test` 29 cases behave; the production run is green.
- **Tests that read the job:** `ui/scripts/__tests__/turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts` and `ensure-chromium-ready.test.ts` pass 52/52, with the 35-minute pin.
- **Workflows parse:** `ci.yml` and `lint.yml` both parse (14 jobs each). `build-e2e-ui` reads `timeout-minutes: 35`, and the new step sits between "Build the @objectstack packages objectui consumes" and "Build the Console for E2E".
- **Gate sweep:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 79 gates. They ran on `468450e19`, this commit before its rebase from `4f7e0414a` to `ff918954e`; nothing on `main` between those touched the five files. 78 exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (prerequisite: no workspace `dist`), then exited 0 after `pnpm build`. `--ran` reconciles 79 derived, 79 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **Push battery** (`GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`) on `468450e19`: 2164 cases pass, 0 fail, EXIT 0 (1586 s).
- **CI:** pending on `d36dc4280`.
